title: Formalize the paired-plane C5 Schur obstruction in Lean
head: ed86bcbe8f728e5412a6ef8f1910bac38f073f51
body:
PR2484's C5 proof leaves its universal Schur algebra outside machine formalization. This package proves the precise core in standalone Lean 4.34.1 / Std: over any commutative ring with 0 != 1, the five-plane, two-port C5 mask cannot satisfy its normalized four-pivot factorization. The 2-by-2 direct-finiteness and cancellation steps are proved, and four additional kernel-checked theorems give an exact integer factorization after freeing the BD zero block.

The formal statement is **no_four_pivot**, not a matrix-rank theorem. The field-rank-to-pivot implication, rank monotonicity/additivity and external source binding remain explicitly outside Lean. The full rank-49 result is credited to thakrarsagar/PR2484. This closes one named algebraic interface without claiming the whole rank-49 theorem is formalized.

The external checker authenticates the original selected archive/member and PR1825 matching, reconstructs all 56 complete binary plane spans, and binds the exact ten-port core plus its isolated I44 block. It verifies the relaxed witness, 880 cross zeros, four mathematical controls and the complete receipt. The registered Python hook checks this finite binding and the recorded formal source hash; its output explicitly says it does not rerun Lean.

Actual local validation: Lean 4.34.1 compiled six named theorems with only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound and rejected four false-premise mutations; CPython 3.12.14 registered optimized checks, unchanged Git-free export, source/receipt/axiom drift and exclusive regeneration passed. Separate AI-assisted source/proof review found no actionable issue. No independent human review, selected supplier cold replay or hosted-CI pass is claimed.

Started from and rechecked canonical main 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2, priority 4. Fresh independent-verification/formal-interface-lemma selection. Final live overlap: 721 open PRs and 1,209 Discussion records, complete pagination at 13:33–13:34 UTC. Advance claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2484#issuecomment-6193177522. Only research/paired-plane-c5-schur-lean/ is added.

No native price, supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change. Credit thakrarsagar/PR2484 and its Schur-proof reviewer, ywz65/PR2471, Cinna Davis/PR1825/PR2126, Adam Gall/PR1889 and the retained geometry/payload lineage. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
